name: session-link
description: Let your Claude Code sessions find and message each other, or make one the host that hands out work to the others

name.title: Session name
name.description: How other sessions see this one (default: folder name + short id)

autoRun.title: Auto-run tasks from the host
autoRun.description: When on, a task the host assigns starts a turn in this session at once. Off: the task is only shown, and runs when you act on it.
